model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for different health per-specialty terms based on a model fine-tuned on Mistralv0.2/Base. Each specialty term has a set of bars representing individual data points or measurements related to that category. The bars are organized in pairs for each specialty set, with each pair consisting of a lighter-colored bar and a slightly darker one, possibly indicating different subcategories or related metrics within the same specialty. The values of the bars vary across the range, showing the relative log probability associated with each term within the specialties. The color-coded legend at the top right corner identifies the shades corresponding to each specialty term, providing an easy reference for interpreting the data displayed in the bars. No bars are distinguished by bold formatting or other means to suggest visual emphasis, and they are sorted in no specific order. The chart does not include any grid lines, tick marks, or additional annotations that would suggest a precise numerical value for each bar or highlight specific trends. It serves as a visual representation for comparing the negative log probability across the different medical specialties based on the given model.
